verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any first-party automation feature that users can version, review, or roll back. The only versioning evidence is API version pinning (the SDK `version` override and the MCP SQUARE_VERSION setting). That is an adjacent control over which Square API version is called, not version history or rollback for user automations. Fraud 'custom rules' and webhooks are likewise adjacent and show no change history or rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
